title: Ring of Mental Inhibition
summary: Failed initial saves against your spells or actions apply Mental Fatigue.

fields.Mental Inhibition: A creature that fails an initial save against your spell or action gains 2 turns of Mental Fatigue. The source reports allies can also be affected. Repeat saves to shake off an effect do not trigger it. Older tests report several area and weapon-passive effects also fail to trigger it.
fields.Mental Fatigue: −1 to Wisdom, Intelligence and Charisma saves per remaining turn. Failing one of those saves with at least 5 turns remaining deals 1d4 Psychic and clears Mental Fatigue. The stated cap is 7 turns, although the visible stack can exceed it.
fields.Acquisition: Locked chest at the House in Deep Shadows, east of the Shadowed Battlefield waypoint.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
